Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-game animation atlas for a throwaway Godot workflow experiment.
Reference image: selected B concept, character identity and palette only. Make a NEW clean usable sprite sheet, no scene, captions, lettering, grid lines or shadows. Transparent background.
EXACT layout: 1536x1024 canvas, six equal columns and four equal rows, 256x256 cells. Every character stays wholly in its own cell, identical size, feet centered at cell x128 y224. Pale hood/seed spirit with asymmetrical two leaf tufts, dark face and cyan eyes, small torso and arms, two short legs. Facing right in three-quarter side view. Crisp true pixel clusters, about 48 logical pixels high magnified 4x, no smooth rendering. Less detail than reference to preserve clarity.
Row 1: four subtly different idle poses in columns 1-4 (breathing), columns 5-6 empty.
Row 2: SIX chronological running cycle poses in columns 1-6, legs and arms actually change, consistent head and size.
Row 3: FOUR chronological rightward swipe poses in columns 1-4: anticipation arm drawn back, extension, full slash follow through, recovery. No weapon, no elemental effects. columns5-6 empty.
Row 4: SIX isolated modular accessories, NO body: column1 orange fiery claw pair, column2 small gold lightning antler pair, column3 green thorn spine cluster, column4 dark slate stone shoulder/back plate cluster, column5 cyan wind fin pair, column6 orange chest ember. Accessories compact, individually centered within cells with ample transparent space, about 8-16 logical pixels in size at same4x scale.
Maintain the SAME neutral character through rows1-3; no upgrades on body. Row4 parts are separate for runtime layering. Strict cell alignment, transparent background, no labels.
background_correction: Edit this sprite atlas only: replace ALL the gray checkerboard background with perfectly solid flat pure magenta #ff00ff, including between arms, legs, accessories and in empty cells. Preserve all sprite pixels, poses, sizes, positions, and colors exactly. No checkerboard, no texture, no shadows, no gradient, no text. This flat magenta will be keyed out by a game shader. Do not rearrange or redraw characters.
